name: Talking to Boop always gets a face, kind or grumpy
case: The person holds Boop's button and says something while an agent works. Boop can't talk back, but it always answers with a face: proud at praise, grumpy at an insult, and a happy face for a question about the tests, maybe saying 'tests'. It never stays quiet when spoken to.
why: PERSONALITY: when the person talks to Boop it always answers with a face, never none; kind words make it proud, rude ones grumpy, and its Examples give each (BEHAVIORS.md §3.3). What you said always wakes the brain (harness/EVENTS.md §6)
